Prepare the test assets

From the repository, export the untrained model and numerical fixtures, install the pinned browser runtime, then run npm run prepare:decoder. See the decoder experiment instructions. Serve the prepared app on localhost or trusted HTTPS. Assets stay on this origin; there is no inference server.
